DDInter458.mechanism: Coadministration with cyclosporine may significantly increase the plasma concentrations of voxilaprevir.  The proposed mechanism is inhibition of organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP) 1B1-mediated hepatic uptake of voxilaprevir by cyclosporine.  Inhibition of P-glycoprotein (P-gp)- and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP)-mediated intestinal transport and CYP450 3A4-mediated metabolism of voxilaprevir may also contribute.
